display.purpose: Page and banner titles; bold uppercase, tight leading (.t-display, guide title, banner titles).

title.purpose: Block and card titles (.t-h3); mega panel titles are a larger sentence-case variant (.mm-title).

lead.purpose: Intro paragraph under a page title, max 52ch (.t-lead).

small.purpose: Notes and secondary text (.t-small); metadata 13px, credits 12px.

label.purpose: Button labels, bold uppercase with +0.04em tracking (.btn).

quote.purpose: Georgia quotations only (.t-quote), with a bold red sans citation.

shadows.name: printed-cover

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Form field focus, with a black border.

shadows.name: scrim

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All movement: indicator, panel height, slides, reveals, lifts (--ease-out).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Defined on :root (--ease-in-out); not used by any rule in the build.

motion.name: hover-colour
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background changes on hover.

motion.name: indicator-slide
motion.purpose: Red 3px nav indicator travelling between items.

motion.name: panel-morph
motion.purpose: Mega panel opening and height change between sections.

motion.name: panel-content-slide
motion.value: 420ms ease-out, 28px in the direction of travel; opacity 260ms

motion.name: close-grace
motion.purpose: Delay before the mega menu closes when the pointer leaves.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals ([data-reveal]); key figures count up.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion; reveals shown at once.

narrative.overview:
The system is the Caritas Internationalis brand guide 2025 played straight, at the craft level of caritas.org: a white ground, black bold Helvetica set tight and often in capitals, Caritas red reserved for what you can act on and where you are, sand bands to group, and a Baie burgundy footer that closes every page. Nothing is rounded, nothing floats without reason; structure comes from a heavy 2px black rule over a list and hairline 1px sand-grey rules between its rows.

Density is editorial rather than dashboard: generous section rhythm (72px between guide sections, 40px between blocks), long readable lines capped by `ch` widths, and components that read as lists, ledgers and frames rather than as floating cards. The header is the signature: one white mega panel stays open as the pointer travels across the five sections, a 3px red indicator slides under the active item, and the panel morphs its height while its content slides in the direction of travel. Each panel says what the section is before listing its pages, then previews something real.

Motion is sober and functional: one long ease-out curve for everything that moves, short colour fades for hover, short reveals on scroll, and everything collapses to near-instant under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black bold sans titles, red only for action and position.
Square corners everywhere (0px), including buttons, fields, chips and cards.
2px black top rule plus 1px `line` row dividers as the default list and table structure.
Sand (`sand`, `sand-2`) as banding and quiet card ground; Baie as the footer.
Photos fill their frames, with a small credit pinned bottom-right.

rules.name: The Red Means Act Rule
rules.body: Rouge Caritas marks something you can click or where you are (button, link, indicator, active item, focus, error). It is not used as decoration or as a large background, except the full-red appeal block that is itself a call to give.

rules.name: The White First Rule
rules.body: White is the dominant ground; sand bands group, Baie closes. A page never opens on a coloured ground.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700 exist (the self-hosted fallback ships only those two). Emphasis is bold, never an intermediate weight.

rules.name: The Caps Are For Titles Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to display and headline titles and to button labels. Body, links, nav items and mega panel titles stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Georgia Is A Voice Rule
rules.body: The serif is used for quotations only, never for headings or UI.

rules.name: The Flat Until It Floats Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it overlays content (mega panel, sticky header) or responds to the pointer (news card, covers). Bands, cards at rest and blocks stay flat.

dos: **Do** keep Rouge Caritas for action and position: buttons, links, the nav indicator, active items, focus and errors.
**Do** open every list, table and ledger with a 2px black top rule and divide its rows with 1px `line` rules.
**Do** keep every corner square (0px), including fields and chips.
**Do** set display and section titles in bold uppercase with tight leading (0.92–0.98) and negative tracking.
**Do** put a small credit on every photo, bottom right.
**Do** use the single ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)`) for movement and plain 160–180ms fades for hover colour; honour reduced motion.
**Do** show a visible 3px focus outline (red on light, white on Baie and dark blocks).
**Do** make every mega panel describe its section before listing pages, each page with a one-line description.
donts: **Don't** round corners or use pill buttons.
**Don't** use red as a decorative fill or for large backgrounds, apart from the appeal block.
**Don't** use Georgia outside quotations, or weights other than 400 and 700.
**Don't** add shadows to surfaces at rest; only overlays and pointer-lifted items get one.
**Don't** give the secondary blue, orange, green or stone a UI role; they are for data and illustration.
**Don't** alter the logo: colour on light grounds, white on Baie and dark, at least 100px wide.
